messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning v1.12.0 release today. Cutoff is 15:00 UTC. Please push any release-blocking PRs and final changelog entries by 14:30. I'll run a tag/publish dry-run at 14:45 and create the GH draft once artifacts are uploaded.

sam: Quick q — bump minor or patch? There was that opt-in metrics change.

maria: Minor. API stays backward compatible; opt-in behavior warrants 1.12.0. The release branch already has the version bump PR merged.

alex: Heads up — CI upload failing for linux-x86 binary: `aws s3 cp build/release.tar.gz s3://redwood-release-artifacts/1.12.0/` returns `403 Forbidden`. Log snippet: 
```
Upload step: aws s3 cp ...
Error: upload failed: s3://redwood-release-artifacts/1.12.0/release.tar.gz An error occurred (403) when calling the PutObject operation: Forbidden
```
Can someone with bucket perms check the ACL/policy?

ci-bot: CI: build #1234 failed on upload step — https://ci.redwood.example/build/1234

jen: I can check the bucket. @ops did we rotate the release-key service account creds recently?

ryan: I didn't rotate anything. @ops / @security please confirm. Also reminder: we sign annotated tags with GPG. I can sign if someone posts the key ID.

release-bot: FYI we use annotated signed tags for releases. Example: `git tag -a v1.12.0 -m 'v1.12.0' && git push origin v1.12.0` — then run the publish script.

maria: For the dry-run, use the `--dry-run` flag on the publish script: `./scripts/publish-release --tag v1.12.0 --artifacts-path s3://redwood-release-artifacts/1.12.0/ --dry-run`. Also please generate sha256 checksums before attaching: `sha256sum release.tar.gz > release.tar.gz.sha256`.

alex: Ops fixed an ACL on the bucket (looks like a missing putObject permission). Requeued the build; I'll ping when artifacts are uploaded.

sam: Can we include a changelog line: "metrics: opt-in stable"? QA uses changelog heuristics to trigger evals.

jen: I will sign the tag. My GPG key: 0xF3A9C8EE. I'll wait for final green CI and the checksum file before pushing. Who will push the annotated tag?

maria: I'll coordinate the push. After tag is pushed I'll create the GH draft release, attach artifacts + checksums, and mark it prerelease until smoke tests clear. @qa-bot please have the smoke checklist ready (smoke, basic perf, canary).

qa-bot: Release checklist: https://redwood.docs/release-checklist — smoke tests, canary 5% traffic, perf sanity.

ryan: I'll hold main branch for cherry-picks until cutoff. Please ping if you want a backport after the tag.

alex: CI green — artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-release-artifacts/1.12.0/release.tar.gz and s3://redwood-release-artifacts/1.12.0/release.tar.gz.sha256

jen: Tag signed and pushed: `git push origin v1.12.0` — release-bot should detect and start the draft creation (dry-run).

release-bot: Detected tag v1.12.0. Starting draft release creation (dry-run). No assets uploaded to GH release yet; waiting on attachments. /cc @maria

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll finalize after smoke pass at ~15:15 UTC. If anything blocks, drop it here. :party:
